name: Hosted Agents — dynamic gateway
summary: Same as hosted-agents-static but routes through the dynamic-discovery APIM connection.
description: Self-provisions the same inline Invocations-protocol agent as `hosted-agents-static` but passes the dynamic-discovery gateway connection name as the container env var. See hosted-agents-static for the full flow. Marker: `slow` — opt-in via `pytest -m slow`.
notes:
**Concept verified via canary**: BYOM dynamic discovery works on the wire.

The `hosted-agents-canary` card probes static and dynamic-discovery gateways from inside the container using `BYOM_MODEL` and `BYOM_MODEL_DYNAMIC`, and `responses-openai-dynamic` returns `ok:true`.

This card still uses `remote_build`, where Foundry builds the container from an inline zip. That path is slower and cold-start-flaky, so the test remains `slow` + `xfail`.
